name: Standing march
description: One knee lifts in front of the body, then the foot returns to the floor. Demonstration configuration for software testing.
instructions: Stand side-on to the screen next to a stable support you can hold.
Lift the knee nearest the camera up in front of you.
Lower your foot back to the floor.

camera.guidance: Stand side-on so the working hip and knee stay in view, with a support within reach.

messages.target_not_reached: Lift your knee a little higher.

setup: Stand side-on to the screen next to a stable support you can hold.
Stand tall with your weight on the leg farther from the camera.

cues.move: Lift the knee nearest the camera up toward the green line.
cues.back: Lower your foot slowly back to the floor.

key_points: Stand tall; avoid leaning back as you lift.
Lift with control rather than swinging the leg.
Hold the support if you need it.
guidance.tempo: About 1–2 seconds up and 1–2 seconds down.

clinical_review.note: Thresholds and dosage are illustrative values for software testing, not clinical targets.
